messages:
Aisha: Quick sync thread 175 - AcmeHealth asked for a per-route cost heatmap + lightweight trace hook. Thinking an MVP in ~6 weeks: heatmap UI, CSV/S3 export, sampling controls, and error grouping. Who wants to help scope?
Cam: +1 from infra. Need to nail rollup strategy. Raw per-token logs will explode. Suggest we store weekly rollups at route+model+region granularity, with optional sampled raw spans.
Jordan: For heatmap UX: model on Y axis, route on X, color = cost per 1k tokens. Filters: time window, customer tier, region, model-variant. Drilldown should surface top contributing traces (if sampled).
Len: Tracing hook plan: emit a tiny span per request with tags: model, route, token_count, batch_size, quant_variant. Default sample rate 0.5% for hosted, 1% for dedicated. Provide a sampling toggle in console.
Maria: CS note: Acme wants cost attribution to product features, not just routes. They need CSV export that includes an "impact" estimate column (monthly cost delta if switching model). Also enterprise customers asked for S3 export + PII masking.
Aisha: MVP scope proposal:
- Heatmap UI with basic filters + CSV export (30-day window)
- Trace hook emission (minimal tags) + sampling controls in UI
- Error analytics: bucket by error class + example failing traces where available
- Enterprise-only: S3 export + opt-in richer spans (KMS-protected)
Cam: Ops constraints to add: ingestion overhead must be <5% at canary. If we hit threshold, fallback to aggregated counters per minute per route/model. Also all spans must be scrubbed of free-text by default.
Jordan: Launch acceptance suggestions:
- Latency: p95 regression <2% for customers in canary
- Cost: ingest/calc overhead <5% vs baseline for typical traffic
- Functionality: CSV export works, sampling toggle controllable, trace links open when spans exist
Len: Quick infra checklist:
```
- span schema: {model, route, tokens, batch, quant_variant}
- sampling default: 0.005 (hosted) / 0.01 (dedicated)
- fallback: emit_aggregate(route, model, minute) if ingest_rate > threshold
```
Aisha: Rollout plan: canary to 10% of non-enterprise accounts for 14 days, monitor p95, error rate, and ingestion cost. If stable, ramp to 50% for 7 days, then full.
Maria: For enterprise export/PII: default masking should remove prompt text and PII tokens. Enterprise can enable full spans with KMS-backed storage and S3 export. I'll collect two customer requirements to validate.
Cam: Also add a soft quota on how many raw spans an account can opt into per month unless we have a paid add-on.
Jordan: Telemetry: add metric for "heatmap_cost_requests" and "trace_span_emitted" and a dashboard to track adoption and cost delta per account. AlertBot: canary started for cohort at 1758889980 :rocket:
Len: Model variants: surface quantization variant in the heatmap (e.g., gpt-j-8bit). That helps customers decide model-switch trades.
Aisha: Updated acceptance criteria (final):
- features: heatmap UI, CSV/S3 export (enterprise), trace emission with sampling toggle, error bucketing
- reliability: p95 latency regression <2%, no error spike in canary window
- cost: ingestion + compute overhead <5% for typical workloads; fallback to aggregates when exceeded
- privacy/security: default PII scrubbing, enterprise opt-in for richer spans behind KMS & ACLs
Jordan: I'll draft the telemetry hooks + dashboard queries. Len + Cam: please produce infra spec and ingestion cost estimate by EOD tomorrow. Maria: confirm export + PII needs with AcmeHealth and one other customer.
Aisha: Thanks team. Follow-up sync in #product next Tuesday.\/end
